title: Sultan Khan v. State of U.P. & 2 Others
coram: Amreshwar Pratap Sahi, J. & Rajiv Lochan Mehrotra, J.
disposition: Writ petition disposed of; Executive Engineer to decide the instalment application under Clause 6.14
headnote: Where the consumer does not dispute the electricity dues and only seeks to pay them in instalments, the matter is one for the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Court disposed of the petition directing the Executive Engineer to pass an appropriate order on the consumer's instalment application under Clause 6.14 within four weeks.

holding_units.topic: Instalment facility for undisputed dues to be decided by the Executive Engineer
holding_units.question: Where the consumer accepts the dues and seeks instalments, who decides?
holding_units.holding: The Executive Engineer, under Clause 6.14, is to consider and pass an appropriate order on the instalment application within four weeks; the dues being undisputed, no other issue arises.
holding_units.limiting_facts: Consumer did not dispute the dues; sought only fixation of instalments.

principle_tags.application: An instalment request for undisputed dues is for the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.14.
